links.outcome: Readability of LLM answers about ACL injury (Flesch-Kincaid Reading Ease and Grade Level)
links.effect: Reading Ease <30 for all sources except Copilot Fact (31.9); all Grade Level scores >13, i.e., college level or above.
links.quote: Similarly, all Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level scores were >13, indicating a minimum readability level of college level or college graduate.

links.outcome: Reading level of AI-generated patient information versus appropriate reading level
links.effect: All three LLMs produced answers at college reading level or above (Grade Level >13; Reading Ease <30 except Copilot Fact at 31.9).
links.quote: Similarly, all Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level scores were >13, indicating a minimum readability level of college level or college graduate.

screen.reason: Empirical comparison of responses to patient questions on ACL injury/repair across three commercial LLM interfaces (Copilot, Gemini, ChatGPT), evaluating quality, reliability, and readability without testing a specific deployment safeguard or practice.
